title: WAO SHOP
problem: WAO! Shop sellers leave the app to find tools for promoting their products.
overview: WAO! Shop helps small business owners sell to their social media communities.
role: I researched seller needs, tested prototypes, and designed features using the existing design system. I worked with developers and stakeholders through short design iterations.
contribution: Research, Usability testing, Competitive audit, Wireframes, Prototypes, Presentations.

sections.title: The project

list: Let sellers promote products within the app.
Encourage repeat use through useful selling tools.
Explore revenue from advertising or premium features.

blocks: New features need to fit familiar workflows. Clear labels and consistent navigation matter as much as the features themselves.

sections.title: Understanding the user
blocks: I interviewed and tested with WAO! Shop socios and super socios, the platform’s sellers.

list: A shorter checkout and clearer delivery information.
Training suited to different experience levels.
Ways to earn and redeem points.

sections.title: Usability Testing
blocks: Testing revealed confusion about redeeming points and using them with clients. Sellers also asked for guidance on payments and delivery, and videos to help explain products.

sections.title: Virtual store
blocks: Sellers create catalogs for their customers, add a name and logo, and host live sessions to introduce products.

sections.title: Feed
blocks: The feed shows activity from other sellers and lets users earn points for participating.

sections.title: Questionnaire
blocks: Questions in four categories help match sellers with resources for their goals.

list: Use consistent navigation and clear labels.
Adapt layouts to different screens and orientations.
Test with sellers of different abilities.
Prioritize accessibility barriers found in testing.
Check whether revisions resolve those barriers.
